_README: Acknowledged false positives that silence specific heuristic-lint findings so genuine ones stand out. Top-level keys are lint categories (the text right after the location prefix, e.g. 'possible missing ezafe'). Within a category, keys are '<book> <chapter>' (matching the source.json book/chapter) and values list findings to suppress as {pair, reason}. 'pair' must match the 'A → B' shown in the lint output exactly (same arrow, same spacing). Only suppress confirmed false positives — never a real issue you simply haven't fixed yet.

1 Nephi 1.reason: در رؤیا 'in vision' (adverbial) then a separate object — not an ezafe phrase
در روزگارم 'in my days' (adverbial) + رنج as object of the verb
مورد لطف 'favored'; روزگارم is adverbial, not the ezafe head
'in that year, [many] prophets…' — clause boundary, not ezafe
با شمشیر + هلاک شدن (to perish) — compound verb
به فرزندانش + سخن گفت (spoke to his children) — compound verb

1 Nephi 2.reason: در بیابان + مسافرت کرد (traveled) — compound verb
علیه پدرشان + غرولند کردند (murmured against their father)
پدرم + سخن گفت (my father spoke) — compound verb
a valley + کنار رود (beside a river) — separate PP, not ezafe
دلش ends the noun phrase; انجام داده است (has done) is the verb
در چادری + ساکن شد (dwelt) — compound verb

1 Nephi 3.reason: از این رو 'therefore' (fixed phrase) + new-clause subject
